name: familyhub
description: Private family website: chat, markets page and settings on Firebase.

scripts.test: npm run test:strings && npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:strings: node --test tests/strings.test.js tests/dates.test.js tests/colors.test.js tests/names.test.js tests/tree-layout.test.js tests/scope.test.js tests/design.test.js
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-familyhub "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rules.test.js tests/rules-family.test.js tests/rules-households.test.js tests/rules-extra.test.js tests/rules-groups.test.js"
